_meta.method: Precision-first per-mood track selection policy, replacing the earlier weighted-similarity ranking (mood match + proximity + polarity + situation) and its single MATCH_THRESHOLD. Fitted on a DEV set of 300 user-labeled tracks: a track qualifies for target mood m when p(m) (from TrackMoodProfile.mood_probabilities) is at or above threshold[m]. Selection rule per mood: precision >= random-baseline precision + 0.15 and recall >= 0.20, maximizing F0.5. Measured on a held-out TEST split: average precision 48% vs. a 32% random baseline, average recall 33%. `fear` has no threshold that clears this bar on either split, so it falls back to a top-1 rule instead: a track qualifies for fear only when fear is its argmax mood (TrackMoodProfile.mood_id), never by a probability threshold.
_meta.selection_rule: precision >= random + 0.15 and recall >= 0.20, maximize F0.5
